task.title: Lazy 96-Node Browser panel

evidence.text: Blocked by a verified gateway/data-contract gap: the tranche mandates s2.graph.list pagination over the named m0-96-node residual set, but the current gateway-method audit reports s2.graph.list and s2.graph.list_by_filter as advertised=false, exists=false, unimplemented. The available s2.graph.query cannot identify the residual 96 because neither the live graph nor dataset exposes a kernel-represented/LUT-lifted discriminator; hardcoding the 12 exclusions in the renderer would fork M0/S2 law and violate M0'-SPEC's no renderer-local LUT rule. Requires an S2-owned typed residual-set query/list method before the UI can be production-honest.
Reopened with substrate ownership clarified: the typed S2 residual-set contract and gateway method are deliverables of this tranche.

task.carrier: CARRIER: M0' one-widget six-panels three-modes (implicate<->explicate one substrate; virtue witness 9-bit LSB-first; 16-fold void ring; DR-M0-1 banner verbatim) in pratibimba-app. §2 track 21.
